component: Existing OS-only rename binding now preserves destination uid/gid and access bits, syncing the staged inode before rename; no SQLite C or new binding.
fault_tests: Temporary-file sync failure and corrupt staging bytes preserve the original byte image. Directory-sync failure after rename exposes the complete new image. All three retries recover the requested contents; pinned SQLite checks integrity and counts.
scope: These injected I/O failures are not physical power-loss tests or a proof that a host filesystem refines AtomicFileReplacement.
